definitions.explanation: A group of people; people in general. The reduplication of {人|ひと} indicates plurality.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{人々|ひとびと}が{集|あつ}まった。
{人々|ひとびと}は{平和|へいわ}を{望|のぞ}んでいる。
この{地域|ちいき}の{人々|ひとびと}は{親切|しんせつ}だ。
examples.english: The people in this area are kind.

notes:
FORMATION: {人|ひと} (person) + {人|びと} (reduplication with rendaku)

The reduplication pattern indicates plurality:
- {人々|ひとびと} (people)
- {国々|くにぐに} (countries)
- {山々|やまやま} (mountains)
- {日々|ひび} (days, daily)

REGISTER: Slightly formal/literary compared to just saying {人|ひと}たち.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人|ひと}たち (people - casual)
- {皆|みな}/{皆|みんな} (everyone)
- {方々|かたがた} (people - honorific)
